messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Ledger is owned by Cinder as of 2026-04-29, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-29-ledger]
    earlier: Ledger is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-12-10, after Team Atlas handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-10 to 2026-04-29; recorded by handover/2025-12-10-ledger]
    earlier: Ledger is owned by Team Atlas as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-12-10; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- Cinder took over Ledger from Boreal on 2026-04-29. [decision; valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-29-ledger]
- The authentication gateway went to team Boreal as of 2025-07-01, not the Cinder team; Cinder never owned it. [decision; valid 2025-07-18 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction]
    earlier: The authentication gateway lives with team Cinder as of 2025-07-01. [decision; valid 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-18; recorded by handover/2025-07-01-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The authentication gateway lives with team Ember. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-07-01; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- Cinder owns the notifier as of 2025-11-19; Boreal owned it until that date. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-notifier]
    earlier: Boreal owns notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- The notifier is owned by team Boreal as of 2026-04-06, after the Cinder team handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-06 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-06-notifier]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by team Cinder as of 2026-03-17. [valid 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-06; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-17]
- Cinder holds team planning on Mondays. [valid 2025-05-02 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-02-2]
- Diego left team Cinder and joined team Ember effective 2025-12-15. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-15]
- The flags service moved from Team Atlas to the Cinder team as of 2025-02-13. [decision; valid 2025-02-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-02-13-feature-flags]
    earlier: Team Atlas looks after the flags service as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-02-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- Diego held the Cinder on-call phone from 2025-11-25 until 2025-12-15, after which Yuki took it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-15]
    earlier: Diego took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-11-25, with Yuki off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-11-25 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-25]
    earlier: Yuki took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-10-02, with Diego off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-10-02 to 2025-11-25; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-02]
    earlier: Diego took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-08-29. [decision; valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-10-02; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-29]
    earlier: Yuki took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-07-22. [decision; valid 2025-07-22 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-22]
- The product catalog lived with the Cinder team from 2025-01-17 until 2025-10-20, when it moved to the Boreal team. [valid 2025-10-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-20-catalog]
    earlier: The product catalog lives with the Cinder team as of 2025-01-17. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-10-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- Team Cinder's on-call swapped on 2025-12-15, with Yuki carrying the Cinder on-call phone. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-15]
    earlier: Team Cinder's on-call swapped on 2025-11-25, with Diego carrying the Cinder on-call phone until the next rotation. [decision; valid 2025-11-25 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-25]
- The product catalog belongs to the Boreal team as of 2025-10-20, after being run by the Cinder team until then. [decision; valid 2025-10-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-20-catalog]
- Boreal owns the indexer as of 2026-04-22, after Team Dune handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the indexer as of 2025-11-18, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to 2026-04-22; recorded by handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction]
    earlier: Ember owns the indexer as of 2025-11-18, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-11-18 to 2025-12-15; recorded by handover/2025-11-18-search-indexer]
    earlier: Boreal still owns the indexer as of 2025-09-15. [valid 2025-09-15 to 2025-11-18; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-15-2]
- The notifier moved from the Cinder team to team Boreal as of 2026-04-06. [decision; valid 2026-04-06 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-06-notifier]

Question: Which team owned the ledger before Cinder took it over?

message.reasoning: The question asks which team owned the ledger before Cinder took it over. Cinder took over Ledger from Boreal on 2026-04-29. So before Cinder, it was Boreal.
